verdict.rationale: Gemini's docs describe user-facing controls. Users can turn off Keep Activity and delete their Gemini Apps activity at any time [31]. They can choose whether Google uses their audio, Gemini Live videos and screenshares to train generative AI models [37]. The docs also state that chats and uploaded files won't be reviewed or used to improve generative AI models [38]. However, the excerpts don't explicitly tie the Keep Activity toggle to text-chat training or say which condition the [38] statement applies to. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that a toggle governs training on text conversations, clarity on what the [38] guarantee depends on (e.g., account type or setting), and independent or hands-on confirmation.
